always: Part of the scene, not a logo lockup. Flies right to left across the top for the whole 20 s (linear), with a slow bob of 7 px and a 1.4° tilt. Never stops, never fades.
Roku City silhouette slides left the full 20 s (linear, very slow). Two purple glows drift with it.

notes.title: Roku Ads Manager lockup
notes.text: Fades in and rises 40 px, 0.10 → 0.60 s, ease out.

notes.title: Headline
notes.text: Two lines, each fades in and rises 60 px: line 1 at 0.25 → 0.80 s, line 2 at 0.45 → 1.00 s, ease out.

notes.title: Step chips
notes.text: Pop in one after the other, 0.18 s apart (1.00 / 1.18 / 1.36 s): scale 80 → 100% with a small overshoot over 0.42 s, fade in over 0.2 s.

notes.title: Out
notes.text: The whole intro fades out and lifts 40 px, 2.05 → 2.45 s, while step 1 comes in.

notes.title: Lockup, step pill, headline
notes.text: Fade in and rise 40 px, 2.40 → 2.95 s, ease out (the headline travels a bit more than the pill).

notes.title: Card
notes.text: Fades in, rises 70 px and scales 94 → 100%, 2.50 → 3.10 s, ease out.

notes.title: Stepper
notes.text: Step 1 active, progress line at one third.

notes.title: Cursor
notes.text: Enters from the bottom right at 3.0 s and glides to the budget field in a slight arc, 3.00 → 3.60 s, ease in-out.

notes.title: Click on the field
notes.text: 3.68 s: cursor dips to 86% for 0.14 s and a white ring expands and fades (0.45 s). The field lights up (focus glow) and the caret starts blinking.

notes.title: Typing
notes.text: 5 → 50 → 500 → 5,000 at 3.95 / 4.10 / 4.25 / 4.40 s, one key every 0.15 s. Caret blinks after the last key.

notes.title: Next
notes.text: Cursor glides to Next 4.70 → 5.35 s, click at 5.45 s: the button presses in 7% and springs back in 0.26 s, ring on the click.

notes.title: Transition to step 2
notes.text: 5.75 → 6.25 s: the step 1 panel slides 70 px left and fades, step 2 slides in from 70 px right; the card grows taller (ease in-out).

notes.title: Headline swap
notes.text: Old pill and headline lift 40 px and fade; the new ones rise 40 px from below, same 0.5 s window.

notes.title: Stepper
notes.text: Step 1 turns into a check, step 2 goes active, the progress line fills to two thirds.

notes.title: Interests field
notes.text: Cursor glides over 6.35 → 6.95 s, click at 7.00 s.

notes.title: Dropdown
notes.text: Opens 7.00 → 7.18 s: fades in and unfolds down from the field (scale Y 85 → 100%), the chevron turns 180°. The hover highlight follows the cursor down the list.

notes.title: Pick
notes.text: Click on Home & Garden at 7.62 s; the menu folds up and fades 7.66 → 7.75 s and the value fills the field.

notes.title: Age 25-34
notes.text: Cursor glides over 7.80 → 8.25 s, click at 8.32 s: the pill fills purple and pops 108 → 100% in 0.25 s.

notes.title: ZIP code
notes.text: Cursor glides over 8.40 → 8.85 s, click at 8.92 s, focus glow. Typing 9 → 90 → 902 → 9021 → 90210 at 9.10 / 9.23 / 9.36 / 9.49 / 9.62 s (one key every 0.13 s).

notes.title: Next
notes.text: Cursor glides to Next 9.75 → 10.30 s, click at 10.38 s with the same press and ring.

notes.title: Transition to step 3
notes.text: 10.55 → 11.05 s: same move as step 1 → 2 (panels slide 70 px, headline and pill swap, card height eases). Step 2 turns into a check, step 3 goes active, progress line full.

notes.title: Upload Content
notes.text: Cursor glides over 11.10 → 11.60 s, click at 11.68 s, press and ring.

notes.title: File row
notes.text: TV_Ad.mp4 fades in and rises 16 px, 11.75 → 12.03 s.

notes.title: Progress
notes.text: Bar fills 0 → 100% from 11.80 to 13.20 s, ease in-out; the % counts up with it.

notes.title: Done check
notes.text: At 13.20 s the check pops in with a small overshoot (0.35 s).

notes.title: Launch Campaign
notes.text: Cursor glides over 13.25 → 13.80 s, click at 13.90 s: press, ring, and the button brightens 25% over 0.3 s.

notes.title: Exit
notes.text: 14.55 → 14.95 s: the card scales up to 105% and fades; lockup, pill, headline and cursor fade with it.

notes.title: Flash
notes.text: White flash builds from 14.70 s to 15.00 s (up to 92%), the cut to the TV happens under it.

notes.title: Cut
notes.text: Hard cut under the flash at 15.00 s: the ad fills the frame. The flash fades out 15.00 → 15.40 s.

notes.title: TV ad playing
notes.text: The ad's progress line on the TV grows from 18% to 46% (15.0 → 17.8 s) so it reads as playing.

16x9.beat: Camera pulls back to the living room

notes.title: Camera pull back
notes.text: One continuous zoom out from the TV glass (full frame) to the whole living room, 15.35 → 17.50 s, ease in-out, centred on the TV. No cut.

notes.title: Out
notes.text: The room fades into the purple end frame, 17.40 → 17.75 s.

notes.text: Fades in and rises 40 px, 17.60 → 18.10 s, ease out.

notes.title: Headline
notes.text: Fades in and rises 60 px, 17.72 → 18.27 s, ease out.

notes.title: CTA button
notes.text: Pops 80 → 100% with a small overshoot, 18.00 → 18.40 s.

notes.title: Cursor
notes.text: Enters from the bottom right at 18.05 s, reaches the button at 18.75 s, click at 18.85 s (press and ring). Hold to 20.0 s.
